Amazon has listed a discount on the Sabrent 8-Port 252W USB Desktop Charging Station, bringing the price down to $59.42 when utilizing a reported coupon code.

Deal and Pricing Overview

  • Merchant: Amazon
  • Market: United States
  • Currency: USD
  • Product/Variant: Sabrent 8-Port 252W USB Desktop Charging Station
  • Verified Price: $59.42
  • Eligibility: Open to general Amazon customers
  • Coupon Terms: Reported 34% off using coupon code `DJK4D88Z`
  • Expiry: Not specified in the source announcement
  • Official Store Link: Available via Amazon product listings

Device Specifications and Features

The charging station includes a total of eight ports designed to accommodate multiple devices simultaneously.

  • Port Configuration: Four USB Type-C ports and four USB Type-A ports
  • Power Output: Type-C ports deliver up to 100W each; Type-A ports deliver up to 18W each
  • Total Simultaneous Output: Capped at a maximum of 252W total output (126W max for USB-C and 126W max for USB-A)
  • Additional Features: Includes an integrated LCD status display to monitor real-time power draw per port

Practical Implications and Verification

Shoppers interested in multi-port desktop chargers can evaluate whether the total 252W cap aligns with their device charging requirements, such as powering laptops, tablets, and gaming handhelds on the USB-C ports alongside lower-draw accessories on the USB-A ports.

To verify the current price, availability, and active coupon terms, buyers should check the official Amazon product page directly, as online pricing and promotional codes are subject to change by the merchant.
